summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares sigvotatug vedotin plus pembrolizumab with pembrolizumab alone as first-line treatment for non-small cell lung cancer in which at least 50% of tumor cells express PD-L1. All participants receive pembrolizumab by IV infusion once every 6 weeks for up to about two years, and half also receive sigvotatug vedotin by IV infusion once every 2 weeks, continued until the cancer is no longer responding. The main outcome is not stated; the study is Phase 3.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 3 compara sigvotatug vedotin más pembrolizumab con pembrolizumab solo como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas en el que al menos el 50% de las células tumorales expresan PD-L1. Todos los participantes reciben pembrolizumab por infusión intravenosa una vez cada 6 semanas durante hasta aproximadamente dos años, y la mitad también recibe sigvotatug vedotin por infusión intravenosa una vez cada 2 semanas, que continúa mientras el cáncer siga respondiendo. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Stage IIIB or IIIC NSCLC that is not a candidate for surgery or definitive chemoradiation, or stage IV NSCLC.
PD-L1 expression in at least 50% of tumor cells, by local testing.
Appropriate candidate for pembrolizumab monotherapy per local guidelines.
Measurable disease based on RECIST v1.1.
not_for: Known EGFR, ALK, ROS1, NTRK, BRAF, RET, or MET alterations with approved first-line therapy available locally.
Prior systemic therapy for advanced NSCLC, including anti-PD-(L)1 therapy, with exceptions for adjuvant or neoadjuvant treatment.
Active central nervous system lesions, with some exceptions for treated or small brain metastases.
Noninfectious or drug-induced interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or DLCO below 50% predicted.
